description_en: This operation deletes a quality check rule. You can access it from the Quality Check Rule Configuration page in the Apsara Stack console. The API endpoint is ip:port/api/client/DeleteRule.json
description_zh: 对应前端功能位置：质检规则配置-删除。专有云URL：ip:port/api/client/DeleteRule.json
name: DeleteRule

parameters.description_en: Whether to delete the rule even if it is associated with a quality check task.
parameters.description_zh: 当规则有关联质检任务时，还是否删除。
parameters.help_en: Whether to delete the rule even if it is associated with a quality check task
parameters.help_zh: 当规则有关联质检任务时，还是否删除
parameters.name: force_delete

parameters.description_en: Indicates whether this is the new version of quality check. 0: old version. 1: new version. Default is 1.
parameters.description_zh: 是否为新版质检，0：旧版质检；1：新版直接。默认为1
parameters.help_en: Indicates whether this is the new version of quality check. 0: old version. 1: new version. Default is 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否为新版质检，0：旧版质检；1：新版直接。默认为1
parameters.name: is_scheme_data
